description: This PHP source file defines the `Blog` class within the Goteo project, responsible for managing blog entities associated with projects and nodes, including retrieval, listing, saving, and update checks.

classes.name: Goteo\Model\Blog
classes.description: Represents a blog linked to either a project or a node, with methods to retrieve, list, validate, save, and check updates for blogs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Blog object and sets its node or project depending on its type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a blog by owner and type ('project' or 'node'), including its posts if applicable.

methods.name: getListProj
methods.description: Returns a list of project-type blogs with their IDs and associated project names.

methods.name: getListNode
methods.description: Returns a list of node-type blogs with their IDs and node names.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the blog object; currently always returns true.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the blog to the database, inserting or updating as necessary, after validation.

methods.name: hasUpdates
methods.description: Checks whether a project has published updates by counting related posts marked as published.
